facts_found: EcoCard sign-up bonus: spend $5,000 in eligible purchases within the first 1 month to earn 2,000 sustainability points; bonus awarded once threshold met and qualifying period closes. [doc_credit_cards_ecocard_001]
EcoCard bonus promo runs 2025-08-01 through 2025-12-15; must be a new customer and the account must be open and in good standing when the bonus is awarded. [doc_credit_cards_ecocard_009]

EcoCard bonus exclusions: returns, chargebacks, and disputed transactions reduce qualifying spend; balance transfers, cash equivalents, and fees do not count toward the $5,000 threshold. [doc_credit_cards_ecocard_009]
Silver Rewards Card sign-up bonus: $500 statement credit when you spend $2,000 in the first 1 month after account opening. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_010]

Silver Rewards Card $500 signup bonus offer window: accounts must be opened within 2025-01-01 to 2025-06-30; keep account open and in good standing through bonus fulfillment; credit typically posts within two billing cycles. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_010]

Business Bronze Rewards Card sign-up bonus: spend $10,000 in net new purchases within the first 2 months of account opening to receive a $500 statement credit. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_bronze_rewards_card_010]

Business Bronze Rewards Card promo window: 2025-10-01 through 2026-03-31; only net purchases count (returns/credits reduce total) and transactions must post within 2 months. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_bronze_rewards_card_010]

Business Silver Rewards Card promo: new customers earn 2x cash back on all purchases for the first 6 months after opening; travel/software normally 10.0% and other purchases normally 1.0% are doubled; no separate enrollment required. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_012]

Business Silver Rewards Card 2x cash back promo period: 2024-11-14 to 2025-11-14; the 6-month window begins on the account opening date and you must open during the promotional period. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_012]

Silver Zoom Card triple cash back promo: promotional earning period runs 9 months from account opening with a 3x multiplier; must be claimed/activated within eligible claim dates 2024-01-01 through 2025-12-31 and account must be open and in good standing. [doc_business_credit_cards_silver_zoom_card_013]

Bronze Rewards Card new-customer promo is 0% APR on carried balances for the first 12 months (promotional window 2025-09-01 through 2026-02-28); standard APR after promo is 20.49%. [doc_credit_cards_bronze_rewards_card_008]
Silver Rewards Card new-customer promo is 0% APR for the first year (offer window 2025-10-15 to 2025-12-31); standard APR after promo is 18.99%. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_009]

Platinum Rewards Card new-customer promo waives the first-year $200 annual fee; promo window was 2024-06-01 to 2024-12-31 (expired) and cannot be applied retroactively. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_009]

Business Silver Rewards Card first-year annual fee waiver promo: window 2025-11-15 to 2026-01-15; standard annual fee after first year is $122.50. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_011]

Business Platinum Rewards Card first-year annual fee waiver promo: window 2025-11-01 to 2026-02-28; standard annual fee after first year is $450.00; new customers only, account must remain open and in good standing. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_platinum_rewards_card_011]

Silver Zoom Card 0% APR on fuel purchases for the first year: accounts opened within 2025-09-15 through 2025-12-31; standard rate after promo is 20.99%. [doc_business_credit_cards_silver_zoom_card_010]

Referral program: bonus amounts and requirements vary by card (cash back, points, or statement credits); up to 2 successful referrals per week; not all cards participate; referred friend must meet spend/timeframe requirements. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_020]

Rewards representation: cash back cards' 'points' convert at 1 point = $0.01 as statement/checking credit; EcoCard is the only true points-based card (sustainability points, also $0.01 per point). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_006]
